## What's changed

A big usability round for the alert view — saved filters, a Pin & Hide label display, settings that follow your account, and a calmer header and card layout — plus a batch of history-database correctness fixes, most of them for PostgreSQL multi-replica setups.

### Breaking Changes
- **Jarvis:** No breaking changes. Existing `?matchers=` links keep working and are rewritten to the new `?filter=` syntax, and a previously configured default filter is migrated into a saved filter named "Default".
- **Helm chart 2.0.0:** Two stricter render checks turn setups that used to deploy broken into a clear `helm install`/`helm upgrade` error. (1) SQLite with `replicaCount > 1` or `autoscaling.enabled` now fails regardless of `persistence.enabled` — every pod would otherwise poll Alertmanager on its own and keep a divergent history. Migration: set `replicaCount: 1` or switch to PostgreSQL (see [docs/persistence.md](https://github.com/kj187/jarvis/blob/main/docs/persistence.md)). (2) `auth.provider` other than `none` now requires `auth.secretKey` or `auth.existingSecret`, and `auth.provider: oidc` additionally requires `auth.oidc.issuer`, `auth.oidc.clientId` and `auth.oidc.redirectUrl` — such releases previously rendered, but the pod never started. Migration: set the missing values. Details in the [chart changelog](https://github.com/kj187/jarvis/blob/main/charts/jarvis/CHANGELOG.md).

### Added
- **Saved filters.** A new menu in the alert toolbar saves the current matcher chips under a name — apply, rename, overwrite or delete them later, and star one as the default that is applied when you open Jarvis without a filter in the URL. It replaces the old "Default Filter" section in Settings.<br><br><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kj187/jarvis/v1.12.0/docs/assets/feature-saved-filters.png" alt="Saved filters menu in the alert toolbar" width="720">
- **Alertmanager-style filter URLs.** Filters are now written to the URL in the matcher syntax you already know from Alertmanager, e.g. `?filter={severity="critical",namespace=~"prod-.*"}`. That's about 2.5× shorter than before, so long filters no longer run into proxy request-line limits.
- **Pin & Hide label display.** Settings → Labels is now a single list: pin a label to show it first (in your order), hide it into a "+N" chip, or leave it as is — with "Hide all" / "Show all" and a fixed 8-color palette that reads well in light and dark theme. The "+N" chip opens hidden labels in a popover, so revealing them no longer shifts cards between columns. Hidden labels stay fully filterable and visible in the detail panel. Proposed in [#189](https://github.com/kj187/jarvis/issues/189) — thanks to @daBo-sh for the detailed proposal!<br><br><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kj187/jarvis/v1.12.0/docs/assets/feature-settings-labels.png" alt="Pin and Hide label settings" width="360">
- **Settings follow your account.** When you're signed in, your preferences are stored on the server and follow you across browsers and devices. Without a login they stay in the browser as before, and logging out never wipes a device's own settings.
- **Grouping right from the toolbar.** The "Grouped" control now opens a popover to switch grouping on or off and pick the label to group by (searchable, with per-label counts) — no detour through Settings anymore.<br><br><img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kj187/jarvis/v1.12.0/docs/assets/feature-grouping.png" alt="Grouping popover with group-by label picker" width="260">
- **Multi-column card grid.** Cards flow into columns balanced by their real height, a section with only a few groups uses the full width, and groups are sorted by most recently fired instead of alphabetically. A new "Card columns" slider in Settings → Display lets you pin the column count (Auto or 1–6).
- **Redesigned header.** Settings, theme toggle and login/logout/admin live in one always-present user menu with an initials avatar; cluster status, refresh and info open on hover and dock directly under the header.
- **One-click claims.** Claiming an alert no longer opens a form — it's claimed immediately under your name, and a "+ Note" link lets you add a note afterwards if you want one.

### Fixed
- **Claims flickering on multi-replica PostgreSQL.** Claiming or releasing an alert showed the change for a moment, then lost it until the next poll whenever the follow-up request landed on another pod. Every pod now applies the claim immediately.
- **Resolved alerts lost their summary and description.** Resolved events were stored without annotations, so the Resolved tab (and the resolved list after a restart) showed alerts without their text. Alerts resolved from now on keep their annotations.
- **Occurrence count stuck at 1** for alerts that re-fire in a different cluster than the one they were first seen in. The count now increases no matter which cluster the alert fires in.
- **Poll loop could stall for good on PostgreSQL** when another pod held the lock for an alert. History writes now give up after a bounded time (10 s lock wait, 30 s overall), so polling keeps going.
- **Duplicate "resolved" entries during a leader failover.** Recording a resolve is now transactional and locked per alert, just like firing events already were.
- **Pods crashing during rolling deploys with PostgreSQL** (`duplicate key value violates unique constraint "pg_type_typname_nsp_index"`) when several pods ran the schema migration at once. Migrations are now serialized.
- **Unpredictable "last event" when two history entries share a timestamp** (common on SQLite), which could throw off grace-period and claim-release decisions.
- **Helm chart: auth secret key missing with `database.existingSecret`.** Using an existing Secret for the database DSN no longer suppresses the generated auth secret key, which left the pod stuck in `CreateContainerConfigError`.
- **Smaller UI fixes:** a duplicate tooltip and missing pointer cursor on label chips, links in alert descriptions now use the accent color, the claim-note field has a visible border again, and locked filter chips no longer point to a Settings gear that no longer exists.

### Changed
- **Calmer alert cards and list rows.** Alerts inside a group lead with the labels that set them apart, group-wide labels are muted, summaries and descriptions are clamped for even row heights, and list-row actions are consolidated into a single silence menu. Claims show as a quiet blue line; claiming and releasing moved to the detail panel. Label chips have one fixed size with the full value on hover, and never render in alarm red.
- **Settings link state.** Opening Settings adds `settings=open` to the URL, so a reload or back/forward keeps the sheet open.
- **Dependency updates:** `pgx/v5` 5.11.0, `golang.org/x/crypto` 0.57.0, plus frontend and GitHub Actions minor/patch updates.

**Full diff:** [v1.11.0...v1.12.0](https://github.com/kj187/jarvis/compare/v1.11.0...v1.12.0)
